summary.text: Robert Bushard is the Republican candidate for Minnesota State Senate District 64 in the November 3, 2026 general election, in which he faces incumbent Erin Murphy (D).

paragraphs.text: In a 2022 Ballotpedia survey, Robert Bushard said he is a lifelong resident of the Merriam Park neighborhood of St. Paul, graduated from St. Paul Central High School in 1965 and then joined the U.S. Air Force, and is a Vietnam veteran.
He said he worked in the information technology industry until retiring in November 2020.
Bushard ran against Erin Murphy for Minnesota State Senate District 64 in 2022, and Murphy won the general election.
In 2023 he was a candidate for St. Paul City Council Ward 4, which Mitra Jalali won in the first round of the ranked-choice count.
In his 2022 survey, Bushard named election integrity, crime and inflation as his key campaign messages.
